subject: science
passage: Mudskippers are fish that spend much of their time out of water, hopping across the mudflats of mangrove swamps on their sturdy front fins. As long as their skin and the lining of their mouths stay moist, they can absorb oxygen through these surfaces, much as frogs do. ______ their bulging eyes, set high on the head, can be pulled down into small, water-filled cups to keep them from drying out in the air.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

explanation.why: The text describes how mudskippers manage out of water. After explaining how they breathe through moist skin, it adds a second, separate adaptation: eyes that can be kept moist. A transition that adds another point is needed.
explanation.A: Incorrect. "Even so" signals something true despite the previous point, but the eye adaptation fits with the previous point.
explanation.B: Correct. "Moreover" adds the eye adaptation as a further way mudskippers cope with life out of water.
explanation.C: Incorrect. The eye cups are not a result of breathing through the skin; they are another adaptation.
explanation.D: Incorrect. "Instead" would mean the eye adaptation replaces breathing through the skin, but mudskippers do both.
